verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents ships official Python and Node.js SDKs for adding programs to rooms as realtime participants, with quickstarts and pytest/Vitest test integration documented. A hands-on probe confirmed both packages are real and installable: pypi livekit-agents 1.8.0 imports without a key, and npm @livekit/agents 1.8.0 is live with about 498k weekly downloads. Missing for 10: SDK API-reference depth and language coverage beyond Python/Node.js are not evidenced.
